sentences.text: An army of volunteers cleaned the whole beach.
sentences.translation: 一大批志愿者清理了整片海滩。
sentences.note: 军队，引申义 —— 一大批人为同一目的聚集。线索是 volunteers，不是军事语境。

sentences.text: The army marched through the capital city.
sentences.translation: 军队穿过首都行进。
sentences.note: 军队，陆军。线索是 marched 与 capital city（首都/首都军区），军事语境明确。

sentences.text: He joined the army when he was eighteen.
sentences.translation: 他十八岁时参了军。
sentences.note: 军队。线索是 joined + 十八岁，是入伍的说法。

sentences.text: The army of ants marched across the path.
sentences.translation: 蚁群穿过小路行进。
sentences.note: 军队，引申义 —— 一大批。线索是 ants（蚂蚁），说明这是「大批」而非军队。

sentences.text: A huge army of fans waited outside the stadium.
sentences.translation: 一大批球迷在场馆外等候。
sentences.note: 军队，引申义。线索是 fans + waited outside stadium，人群而非部队。

cards.glossEn: a large number of people united for some specific purpose

sentences.text: He kept an army of assistants at his company.
sentences.translation: 他在公司里配了一批助手。
sentences.note: 大批人（雇员）。线索是 assistants + at his company，是雇员群体。

sentences.text: A whole army of workers joined the strike.
sentences.translation: 整整一大批工人加入了罢工。
sentences.note: 大批人。线索是 workers + strike（罢工），是劳工群体。

sentences.text: She has an army of siblings to support her.
sentences.translation: 她有一大群兄弟姐妹支持她。
sentences.note: 大批人。线索是 siblings，是家族群体。

sentences.text: The army of bicycles filled the parking lot.
sentences.translation: 大批自行车塞满了停车场。
sentences.note: 大批人/物。线索是 bicycles，说明是「大批自行车」而非人群。

sentences.text: Facing the task, he felt like an army of one.
sentences.translation: 面对这项任务，他觉得自己孤军奋战。
sentences.note: 大批人（引申为一大群）。线索是 like an army of one（孤军一人），强调「一个人也算一支队伍」。

cards.glossEn: a distinct feature or element in a problem a characteristic to be considered

sentences.text: The financial aspect of the plan worries him most.
sentences.translation: 这个计划的财务方面最让他担心。
sentences.note: 方面；面貌（看待某问题的一个要素）。线索是 financial + of the plan，指计划里的一个考量维度。

sentences.text: We should consider every aspect of the problem.
sentences.translation: 我们应该考虑这个问题的每个方面。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 consider every aspect of，是固定搭配。

sentences.text: One aspect of the design still looks unfinished to me.
sentences.translation: 这个设计有一处让我觉得还没完成。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 One aspect of the design，指设计里的某一处。

sentences.text: The legal aspect was completely new to us.
sentences.translation: 法律这一方面对我们来说完全是新的。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 legal（法律的）+ was new to us，指知识领域。

sentences.text: From a practical aspect, the plan seems workable.
sentences.translation: 从实际角度看，这个方案似乎可行。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 From a ... aspect，是介词短语引出视角。

sentences.text: Nobody studied the political aspect of the case.
sentences.translation: 没有人研究过这个案件的政治层面。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 political + of the case，指案件的一个维度。

sentences.text: The worst aspect was the long waiting time.
sentences.translation: 最糟糕的方面是漫长的等待时间。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 the worst aspect was，指其中最差的一项。

sentences.text: She questioned one aspect of his argument carefully.
sentences.translation: 她仔细质疑了他论证中的一个方面。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 one aspect of his argument，指论证里的某一环。

cards.glossEn: the beginning or duration or completion or repetition of the action of a verb

sentences.text: His face showed a different aspect after years abroad.
sentences.translation: 在国外多年后，他的脸显出另一种神采。
sentences.note: 面貌，外观。线索是 face showed a ... aspect，指人的神情外貌。

sentences.text: We must see both sides of the problem, not just one aspect.
sentences.translation: 我们必须看到问题的两面，而不只是一个方面。
sentences.note: 方面。线索是 not just one aspect，强调片面性。

sentences.text: The verb "was" has a past aspect and a present one.
sentences.translation: 动词 was 有过去体和现在体两种。
sentences.note: （语法）时、体。线索是 verb + past/present aspect，是语法学的时态体貌术语。

sentences.text: In that grammar book each tense has four aspects.
sentences.translation: 那本语法书里每个时态有四个体。
sentences.note: （语法）时、体。线索是 tense（时态）+ four aspects，指时态系统。

sentences.text: The verb "run" carries the aspect of motion.
sentences.translation: 动词 run 带有动作体的特征。
sentences.note: （语法）时、体。线索是 the aspect of motion（动作体），语法学术语。

cards.glossEn: be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
take charge of or deal with
to accompany as a circumstance or follow as a result
give heed (to)
a gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance

sentences.text: The audience clapped for ten minutes after the show.
sentences.translation: 演出结束后观众鼓掌了十分钟。
sentences.note: 听众，观众（在场）。线索是 clapped + after the show，是演出散场时的反应者。

sentences.text: She spoke to the audience without notes.
sentences.translation: 她不看讲稿地对听众讲话。
sentences.note: 听众，观众。线索是 spoke to + without notes，是当众讲话。

sentences.text: His lecture drew a small but quiet audience.
sentences.translation: 他的讲座吸引了一小群安静的听众。
sentences.note: 听众，观众。线索是 lecture（讲座）+ quiet，说明是小规模听讲者。

sentences.text: The audience at the concert hall was mostly elderly.
sentences.translation: 音乐厅的听众大多是老年人。
sentences.note: 听众，观众。线索是 concert hall（音乐厅），是演出场所。

sentences.text: Never talk back to the audience, the director said.
sentences.translation: 导演说：永远不要跟观众顶嘴。
sentences.note: 听众，观众。线索是 talk back to + director 的告诫语气。

cards.gloss: 读者，观众（某内容的受众）
cards.glossEn: the part of the general public interested in a source of information or entertainment

sentences.text: Her book found a wide audience among young readers.
sentences.translation: 她的书在年轻读者中拥有广泛的读者群。
sentences.note: 受众（某内容的接受者）。线索是 among young readers，指阅读这本书的人，不是在场听看。

sentences.text: The show was written for a family audience.
sentences.translation: 这场演出是为家庭观众写的。
sentences.note: 受众。线索是 for a + 某类人群（family），指目标观众群体而非在场者。

sentences.text: His technical papers reach a narrow academic audience.
sentences.translation: 他的技术论文读者群很窄。
sentences.note: 受众。线索是 technical papers + academic（学术），指专业读者。

sentences.text: The advertisement targets a young male audience.
sentences.translation: 这则广告瞄准的是年轻男性受众。
sentences.note: 受众。线索是 advertisement + targets，指广告投放的目标人群。

sentences.text: Sorry, this film contains violence not suitable for young audience.
sentences.translation: 抱歉，本片含有不适合年轻观众的暴力内容。
sentences.note: 受众。线索是 not suitable for + 某类观众，是内容分级用语。
